# BrowserBud

> BrowserBud is a screen-aware AI companion for desktop browsers. You share a tab or your screen, bring your own Gemini API key, and BrowserBud answers questions about what is on screen, saves notes and context, and leaves behind a structured activity log and session recap.

## Product

- [Home](https://browserbud.com/): product overview, features, and how it works
- [Open the app](https://browserbud.com/app): the BrowserBud alpha. Desktop browser only; requires the user's own Gemini API key, entered inside the app

## Workflows

- [Screen-aware notes](https://browserbud.com/workflows/screen-aware-notes): how BrowserBud captures notes from what you are looking at
- [Research session recap](https://browserbud.com/workflows/research-session-recap): how a browsing session becomes a reusable recap
- [Ask questions about the current page](https://browserbud.com/workflows/ask-questions-about-current-page): voice-first Q&A grounded in the page on screen

## Comparisons

- [BrowserBud vs ScreenHelp](https://browserbud.com/vs/screenhelp): neutral feature comparison with cited sources
